metadata.name: crossy_world
metadata.description: Crossy World — contract-first realtime grid competition on Solana + MagicBlock

accounts.name: selected_variant
docs: The variant that will be reserved (selected deterministically; the
handler re-derives the selection and requires this account to match).

accounts.name: team_treasury
docs: Team treasury: assignment finalizes the revenue.

accounts.name: vrf_authority
docs: The authenticated randomness identity fixed in config.

accounts.name: run
docs: PDA + discriminator in the handler.

accounts.name: payer_token
docs: Payer's USDC account.

accounts.name: buyer_token
docs: Buyer's USDC account.

accounts.name: seller_token
docs: Seller proceeds: canonical USDC account owned by the listing seller.

accounts.name: sector
docs: Sector containing the run's current tile.

accounts.name: drift_sector
docs: Sector the player drifts into when a log carries them across a sector
boundary; None when the drift stays inside `sector` or cannot happen.

accounts.name: chunk
docs: Chunk covering the run's current row.

accounts.name: asset
docs: New asset keypair (client-generated, signs creation).

accounts.name: asset_map
docs: Program-owned asset -> class binding, written now.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Permissionless sponsor pays rent/fees; owner is fixed above.

accounts.name: wallet_token
docs: Fixed recipient: the contribution wallet's canonical USDC account.

accounts.name: receipt
docs: Revival receipt: cloned base account, read-only payment evidence.

accounts.name: safe_sector
docs: Sector containing the saved safe tile (revival placement).

accounts.name: class_config
docs: The class this variant maps to must exist (any version).

accounts.name: sector
docs: Sector containing the run's current tile (occupancy release).

accounts.name: chunk
docs: The next chunk, already revealed on base and read cross-plane here.

accounts.name: winner_token
docs: Winner USDC token account: must belong to the recorded winner and the
canonical mint. The admin supplies the account but cannot substitute
the owner. On a no-winner day (settled_score == 0) no winner transfer
occurs, so any canonical-mint token account satisfies the slot.

accounts.name: team_treasury
docs: Team treasury fixed by config.

accounts.name: world
docs: (owner = delegation program), so a typed Account would reject it —
the handler validates address + discriminator via
`read_committed_world` and reads the immutable day window from the
committed data.

accounts.name: world
docs: typed account would reject it and no sector could ever be created for
newly revealed rows. The handler validates it by committed read +
mode/day PDA derivation, exactly like `init_run`.

accounts.name: chunk
docs: Chunk covering this sector's rows (blocker derivation). Its address is
pinned in the handler against the committed world's day, since the
day is not available to the seeds expression here.

accounts.name: usdc_mint
docs: Canonical USDC mint; decimals verified.

accounts.name: team_treasury
docs: Team treasury token account for the canonical mint.

accounts.name: collection
docs: collection creation; stored for later strict comparisons.

accounts.name: target
docs: The player being kicked. Optional: a kick thrown at empty space is a
legal, wasted kick rather than a failed transaction.

accounts.name: target_sector
docs: Sector containing the target's current tile.

accounts.name: dest_sector
docs: Sector containing the knockback destination; None when it shares the
target's sector (Anchor forbids duplicate mutable accounts).

accounts.name: chunk
docs: Chunk covering the knockback destination row.

accounts.name: asset_map
docs: Program-owned asset mapping (collection membership proof).

accounts.name: world
docs: Target world for this attempt (address recorded in the lock).
handler (may be delegated).

accounts.name: asset
docs: The Core asset being locked. `Pubkey::default()`-marker starters use
`lock_starter` instead.

accounts.name: asset_map
docs: Program-owned asset -> variant/class binding written at mint.

accounts.name: listing
docs: No active listing may exist for the asset (lock/listing mutual
exclusion): the listing PDA must not be an initialized active listing.

accounts.name: world
docs: Mutable: a move into a hazard window is fatal, and death updates the
world's active-player count.

accounts.name: source_sector
docs: Source sector (must match the run's current tile).

accounts.name: dest_sector
docs: Destination sector for cross-sector moves; None when the destination
shares the source sector (Anchor forbids duplicate mutable accounts).

accounts.name: chunk
docs: Chunk covering the destination row.

accounts.name: vault
docs: Day vault token account owned by the vault authority PDA.

accounts.name: spawn_chunk
docs: The safe/spawn chunk (index 0) is deterministic — created revealed.

accounts.name: world
docs: typed account would reject it. The handler validates it by committed
read + mode/day PDA derivation.

accounts.name: prev_chunk
docs: Continuity anchor: the preceding chunk must already be revealed, so
the revealed range can never gain a hole.

accounts.name: vrf_authority
docs: The authenticated randomness identity fixed in config.

accounts.name: paid_world
docs: The paid world account, now undelegated and committed back to base.
Ownership by this program proves undelegation completed; its record
fields are the final authority.

accounts.name: wallet_token
docs: Fixed recipient: the pull player's canonical USDC account.

accounts.name: wallet_token
docs: Destination: the receipt wallet's canonical USDC account. Fixed
recipient; the caller may be anyone (permissionless sponsorship).

accounts.name: gacha_vault
docs: Gacha vault token account (held pending until assignment/refund).

accounts.name: vrf_authority
docs: The authenticated randomness identity fixed in config.

accounts.name: receipt
docs: Entry receipt (paid mode): cloned base account, read-only evidence of
finalized payment. Casual mode passes the world account here instead.

accounts.name: agent_lock
docs: Agent lock for this attempt: program-derived class binding.

accounts.name: run
docs: terminal; or the day cutoff proves it (validated in handler).

accounts.name: world
docs: day-cutoff evidence. Address fixed by the lock; validated in handler.

accounts.name: class_config
docs: Class config for the caster's class at the run's balance version.

accounts.name: target
docs: Target run for Ram/Hook/Swap; None for untargeted kinds.

accounts.name: caster_sector
docs: Sector covering the caster's current tile.

accounts.name: dest_sector
docs: Second sector for cross-sector destinations/effects; None when all
touched tiles share the caster's sector.

accounts.name: chunk
docs: Chunk covering the destination/effect row.

errors.name: NotAdmin
errors.msg: signer is not the configured admin

errors.name: NotProposedAdmin
errors.msg: signer is not the proposed admin

errors.name: NotWallet
errors.msg: signer is not the owning wallet

errors.name: BadSession
errors.msg: signer is not the registered session authority

errors.name: SessionScope
errors.msg: session scope does not permit this action

errors.name: BadVrfAuthority
errors.msg: callback identity is not the authenticated VRF authority

errors.name: TimeoutNotReached
errors.msg: objective timeout has not been reached

errors.name: ActivationNotReached
errors.msg: activation day has not been reached

errors.name: WrongCollection
errors.msg: asset is not in the configured collection

errors.name: BadClassMapping
errors.msg: class or variant mapping is invalid or inactive

errors.name: AgentLocked
errors.msg: agent is locked for an active attempt

errors.name: AgentListed
errors.msg: agent is listed on the marketplace

errors.name: WrongAmount
errors.msg: payment amount does not match program-derived amount

errors.name: BadReceiptState
errors.msg: receipt is not in the required state

errors.name: ReceiptMismatch
errors.msg: receipt does not match this run/attempt/death nonce

errors.name: PityInventoryUnavailable
errors.msg: required pity inventory unavailable; banner paused

errors.name: AlreadyTerminal
errors.msg: already consumed, refunded, claimed, or settled

errors.name: DayNotOpen
errors.msg: day is not prepared/open for this operation

errors.name: BadRunState
errors.msg: run is not in the required state

errors.name: AttemptStillActive
errors.msg: another attempt is still active for this wallet

errors.name: TooFast
errors.msg: movement cadence exceeded for this slot

errors.name: LethalTile
errors.msg: tile is lethal at the authoritative time

errors.name: BadAbility
errors.msg: ability not available for this class/version

errors.name: FrontierClosed
errors.msg: chunk frontier is closed; wait for reveal

errors.name: WrongSector
errors.msg: wrong sector account for these coordinates

errors.name: BadChunkState
errors.msg: chunk is not in the required state

fields.name: direction
docs: Direction for directional abilities (Dash/Ram/Hook/Leap/Phase).

fields.name: target_x
docs: Target tile for placed effects (Trap/TimeSlow/AreaStun/LaneShift).

types.name: AbilityKind
docs: Closed set of ability kinds. Adding one requires a program upgrade —
never client-supplied scripts or arbitrary effect payloads.

types.name: AgentLock
docs: PDA: ["agent_lock", world, wallet, attempt_nonce_le]
Binds asset, owner, world, and attempt. `asset == Pubkey::default()` is
the starter marker (nothing to freeze/thaw).

fields.name: class_id
docs: Program-derived gameplay class (from the asset's `AssetMap`, or 0 for
the starter). Spawn reads this — never a client-supplied class.

fields.name: frozen
docs: True while the Core asset is frozen for this attempt.

fields.name: unlocked
docs: Terminal unlock completed (idempotent thaw).

types.name: AssetMap
docs: PDA: ["asset_map", asset]
Immutable binding written at claim-mint time: the program-owned truth of
which variant/class an asset embodies. Off-chain metadata is display-only.

types.name: Banner
docs: PDA: ["banner", season_le, tier]

fields.name: tier
docs: 0 = Standard (5), 1 = Enhanced (10), 2 = Premium (20).

fields.name: price
docs: Price in USDC base units; immutable after season start.

fields.name: base_weights
docs: Base weights [common, rare, epic, legendary], sum 100; immutable
after season start.

fields.name: inventory_revision
docs: Bumped whenever any variant's availability changes (sold out, pause).

types.name: ChunkDefinition
docs: PDA: ["chunk", utc_day_le, chunk_index_le]
One revealed definition is shared by both paid and casual modes.

fields.name: row_start
docs: First absolute row of this chunk (chunk_index * 16).

fields.name: row_count
docs: Fixed 16.

fields.name: generation
docs: VRF request generation this chunk was revealed under.

fields.name: randomness_hash
docs: Commitment to the raw randomness for auditability.

fields.name: generation_version
docs: Deterministic generator version.

types.name: ClassConfig
docs: PDA: ["class", class_id_le, version_le]

fields.name: cooldown_seconds
docs: Fixed cooldown 10..=30 seconds.

fields.name: range
docs: Targeting range in tiles (bounded by MAX_ABILITY_RANGE).

fields.name: duration_seconds
docs: Effect duration seconds (bounded by MAX_EFFECT_DURATION_SECONDS).

fields.name: displacement
docs: Displacement magnitude in tiles for push/pull/dash kinds.

fields.name: param_a
docs: Bounded kind-specific parameters (e.g. slow permille, stun ms).

fields.name: min_rarity
docs: Minimum rarity allowed to reference this class (pay-to-win is
intentional and disclosed).

fields.name: activation_day
docs: UTC day at which this version activates (future day boundary only).

types.name: DailyBest
docs: PDA: ["best", world, wallet]
Every wallet writes its own best account; indexers sort them for pages.
The prize record itself lives in `WorldHeader`.

types.name: DailyCompetition
docs: PDA: ["daily", utc_day_le]

fields.name: paid_world
docs: Paid world PDA (delegated gameplay root).

fields.name: casual_world
docs: Casual world PDA.

fields.name: vault
docs: Canonical day vault token account (owned by the vault authority PDA).

fields.name: rollover_in
docs: Rollover received from the previous day (part of active pool).

fields.name: rollover_out
docs: Rollover paid forward after a no-winner day.

fields.name: pending_total
docs: Payments received but not yet reconciled to an ER outcome.

fields.name: active_pool
docs: Consumed entries/revivals forming the day's prize pool
(includes rollover_in once opened).

fields.name: refund_liability
docs: Refundable receipts + void-day contributions awaiting claims.

fields.name: winner_unpaid
docs: Fixed winner obligation after finalize (unpaid leg).

fields.name: team_unpaid
docs: Fixed team obligation after finalize (unpaid leg).

fields.name: rollover_consumed
docs: Set once the rollover was consumed into a successor day.

fields.name: final_commit_slot
docs: Slot at which the final world record commit was observed on base.

types.name: DailyContribution
docs: PDA: ["contribution", utc_day_le, wallet]
Makes void refunds independent and idempotent per wallet without an
unbounded payer list in `DailyCompetition`.

fields.name: entry_total
docs: Consumed (activated) entry payments.

fields.name: revival_total
docs: Consumed (activated) revival payments.

fields.name: refunded_total
docs: Already refunded on a voided day.

types.name: GachaPull
docs: PDA: ["pull", player, pull_nonce_le]

fields.name: price
docs: Exact USDC price paid (held in the gacha vault until terminal).

fields.name: effective_weights
docs: Snapshot of effective weights shown before payment.

fields.name: epic_misses_snapshot
docs: Snapshot of pity counters at request time.

fields.name: inventory_revision
docs: Banner inventory revision at request; a callback whose required
selection was invalidated by concurrent assignment refunds instead of
silently using newer odds.

fields.name: request_generation
docs: VRF request generation; a refund invalidates the generation and a
late callback from an older generation must fail.

fields.name: inventory_reserved
docs: True while one supply unit is reserved and unminted.

fields.name: minted_asset
docs: Minted Core asset (set on claim).

fields.name: admin
docs: V1 single admin (two-step rotation to allow future multisig handoff).

fields.name: pending_admin
docs: Pending admin of an in-flight rotation (None when idle).

fields.name: usdc_mint
docs: Canonical USDC mint. Every USDC account is checked against it.

fields.name: token_program
docs: Supported SPL token program for the canonical mint.

fields.name: team_treasury
docs: Team treasury USDC token account (settlement + royalties + gacha).

fields.name: collection
docs: Verified Metaplex Core collection for agent assets.

fields.name: collection_authority
docs: Update authority configured for the collection.

fields.name: vrf_authority
docs: Authenticated randomness callback identity. Only this signer may
deliver chunk/gacha randomness (the MagicBlock VRF integration point;
binding, generation, and idempotency rules live in the handlers).

fields.name: pause_flags
docs: Pause bitmask (see `pause`).

fields.name: winner_bps
docs: Winner basis points: 9000.

fields.name: team_bps
docs: Team basis points: 1000.

fields.name: max_paid_players
docs: Maximum concurrent paid players (<= HARD_MAX_PLAYERS).

fields.name: max_casual_players
docs: Maximum concurrent casual players (<= HARD_MAX_PLAYERS).

fields.name: version
docs: Configuration version for upgrade compatibility.

types.name: Lane
docs: Borsh-friendly lane mirror of the kernel `LaneDescriptor`.

types.name: MarketplaceListing
docs: PDA: ["listing", asset]

fields.name: price
docs: Nonzero USDC base units.

fields.name: expiry_ts
docs: 0 = no expiry.

types.name: OccupancySector
docs: PDA: ["sector", world, sector_x, sector_y_le]
8x8 tiles; occupancy + static blockers as bitsets, bounded effect slots.

fields.name: occupancy
docs: One bit per tile (bit = local_y * 8 + local_x). One live player per
tile, enforced atomically by movement/spawn/displacement handlers.

fields.name: blockers
docs: Static blockers derived from the revealed chunk rows.

fields.name: seq
docs: Monotonic sequence for client gap detection.

types.name: PaymentReceipt
docs: PDA: ["payment", kind, day_le, wallet, receipt_nonce_le]

fields.name: run
docs: The PlayerRun this payment is bound to.

fields.name: death_nonce
docs: Revival only: the exact death this payment revives.

fields.name: revive_index
docs: Revival only: successful revive count at purchase (prices the leg).

fields.name: amount
docs: Exact USDC amount moved into the vault.

fields.name: receipt_nonce
docs: Wallet-scoped receipt nonce (from PlayerProfile counter or run state).

types.name: PlayerProfile
docs: PDA: ["player", wallet]

fields.name: starter_claimed
docs: One-time non-transferable starter entitlement.

fields.name: pity
docs: Per-banner-tier pity counters [standard, enhanced, premium]; carry
across seasons.

fields.name: pull_count
docs: Sequential nonce for gacha pull PDAs.

fields.name: receipt_count
docs: Sequential nonce for payment receipt PDAs.

fields.name: total_paid_wins
docs: Authoritative daily wins, all time.

fields.name: season_wins
docs: Wins in `wins_season`.

types.name: PlayerRun
docs: PDA: ["run", world, wallet]
One account per wallet per world, reused across attempts by incrementing
`attempt_nonce`. Never two active attempts simultaneously.

fields.name: session_authority
docs: Registered session signer for gameplay actions.

fields.name: session_rotation
docs: Rate limit + binding for session rotation.

fields.name: agent_asset
docs: Selected Core asset; Pubkey::default() = starter marker.

fields.name: facing
docs: Facing direction (grid::Direction as u8), updated by accepted moves.

fields.name: score
docs: Furthest forward row = authoritative score for this attempt.

fields.name: safe_x
docs: Last verified safe tile (revival placement policy).

fields.name: last_move_slot
docs: One accepted movement per ER slot.

fields.name: action_seq
docs: Exact-next action sequence; consumed by successfully executed actions.

fields.name: shield_until
docs: Guardian shield: absorbs one environmental collision until expiry.

fields.name: anchor_until
docs: Anchor: ignores forced movement until expiry.

fields.name: entry_receipt
docs: Receipt PDAs currently bound to this attempt (entry / latest revival).

fields.name: hazard_nonce
docs: Hazard scheduling: stale-nonce protection for crank checks.

fields.name: hazard_deadline_ms
docs: Next scheduled hazard deadline in ms since world start (0 = none).

fields.name: last_committed_state
docs: Reconciliation markers: committed state observed by base instructions.

types.name: ReceiptState
docs: Receipt terminal-state machine:
`Pending -> Consumed` XOR `Pending -> Refundable -> Refunded`.

types.name: Season
docs: PDA: ["season", season_index_le]

fields.name: start_day
docs: Inclusive start day.

fields.name: end_day
docs: Exclusive end day (start + 30).

fields.name: weights_hash
docs: Hash over the immutable banner base weights (auditable immutability).

fields.name: class_balance_version
docs: Class-balance version snapshot for this season.

fields.name: metadata_version
docs: Metadata base URI version.

fields.name: variant_count
docs: Number of registered variants (bounded by MAX_SEASON_VARIANTS).

types.name: TempEffect
docs: Bounded temporary effect stored in a sector. Expired slots are reusable;
full slots reject new effects rather than evicting unpredictably.

fields.name: kind
docs: 0 = empty slot. Mirrors AbilityKind for placed effects.

fields.name: magnitude
docs: e.g. slow permille for Trap/TimeSlow, unused otherwise.

fields.name: source
docs: Originating run (kick/ability attribution for UI; no kill credit).

types.name: VariantInventory
docs: PDA: ["variant", season_le, variant_id_le]

fields.name: class_id
docs: Gameplay class this variant maps to (program-owned truth).

fields.name: rarity
docs: Rarity 0..=3.

fields.name: model_id
docs: Voxel model identifier (asset manifest key).

fields.name: cosmetic_id
docs: Cosmetic variant identifier.

fields.name: metadata_uri_hash
docs: Hash of the metadata URI template for this variant.

fields.name: supply_cap
docs: Seasonal mint cap; immutable after season start.

fields.name: reserved
docs: Assigned-but-unminted reservations.

fields.name: minted
docs: Successfully minted count. reserved + minted <= supply_cap.

types.name: WorldHeader
docs: PDA: ["world", mode, utc_day_le]

fields.name: start_ts
docs: Authoritative day window (derived from `day`, stored for cheap checks).

fields.name: width
docs: Fixed 64.

fields.name: safe_rows
docs: Safe-zone rows [0, safe_rows).

fields.name: revealed_rows
docs: Number of revealed rows; the frontier. Movement at/above this row is
rejected (fail closed at an unrevealed boundary).

fields.name: record_score
docs: Current record: score, holder, attempt, slot. The ONLY prize authority.

fields.name: next_chunk_index
docs: Chunk pipeline: index the next request will target and its state.

fields.name: chunk_generation
docs: VRF request generation for the in-flight chunk request.

fields.name: class_balance_version
docs: Class-balance version snapshotted at preparation.

fields.name: action_domain
docs: Domain for action-envelope uniqueness.

fields.name: commit_payer
docs: Authorized commit/crank fee payer reference.
